Frequently asked questions

Is the personality test the official MBTI?

No. It's a free Myers-Briggs–style questionnaire inspired by the same four dimensions. It's great for self-reflection but isn't the official, certified instrument.

How does the Rubik's cube solver work?

Enter your cube's colors on the 3D model or scan it with your camera, and the solver computes a step-by-step solution you can follow move by move.

How is cricket net run rate calculated?

NRR is runs scored per over minus runs conceded per over across the tournament. When a team is bowled out, the full quota of overs counts, which the calculator handles automatically.
